subject: table: add new option `DupKeyCheckMode` for table mutations (#55194)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for executor/sessionctx/table. Change removes global `StmtCtx.BatchCheck` and replaces it with per-mutation `table.DupKeyCheckMode` threaded through `Table.AddRecord`/`UpdateRecord` and `Index.Create`. Verified `DupKeyCheckSkip` is only used in paths that already pre-check duplicate keys (batch insert-ignore/replace/load-data `batchCheckAndInsert`, and `ADMIN RECOVER INDEX` via `batchMarkDup`), so correctness/txn semantics (dup-key detection, assertions, FK checks) are preserved. No later commits on `origin/master` modify the `DupKeyCheck*` logic in these modules.
